post_caption: REVIEW: The Comfy Cow's Simply Southern

comments.text: You seem to get a lot of bum pints, lacking mix-ins. Hope that changes for you! Sorry that that keeps happening. As for this particular ice cream - good to know (despite the lack of pie pieces) that it's a good flavor. I actually watched a special a few weeks ago on the making of the Comfy Cow Simply Southern ice cream flavor: http://www.cookingchanneltv.com/shows/kimberlys-simply-southern/300/the-scoop-on-ice-cream.html
